data.content: {"story":{"as_a":"user managing my to-do list","i_want":"to mark a task as Completed","so_that":"I can record that the work on the task is done","business_description":"The user marks an existing task as Completed from the task list. The backend stores the status Completed and the Completion Date. The frontend shows the new status and a success message only after the backend confirms the change. Open and In Progress are set through the edit form, not through this action.","business_value":"The task list and reports reflect which tasks are done, and the user gets confirmation of each change.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"a task with status Open or In Progress exists","when":"the user marks the task as Completed","then":"the backend stores the status Completed and the task list shows the task with status Completed"},{"given":"a task with status Open or In Progress exists","when":"the user marks it as Completed and the backend returns success","then":"a success message is displayed and the row shows the status Completed"},{"given":"the status change request for an existing task fails in the backend","when":"the frontend receives the failure","then":"the task list still shows the previous status and an error message is displayed"},{"given":"a status change request is pending and the backend has not responded yet","when":"the task list is displayed","then":"the row still shows the previous status and no success message is displayed"},{"given":"a status change request is sent for a task ID that does not exist","when":"the backend processes the request","then":"the backend returns a task not found error and no stored task changes"},{"given":"a status change request is sent with a status value other than Completed, including Open or In Progress","when":"the backend validates the request","then":"the backend rejects the request with an invalid input error and the stored status does not change"},{"given":"a task is marked as Completed","when":"the backend saves the change","then":"the Completion Date field of the task is populated with the time of the change"}],"edge_cases":["The status endpoint accepts only Completed;
